The entire piece is framed by pronounced geometric border bands composed of continuous chevron patterns, reinforcing the structured nature of the textile. The work remains completely static as required, presenting a detailed, symmetrical composition that demonstrates both mathematical precision and artistic design through its repetitive yet varied pattern construction.
